name: Code Defect Exploitation
definition: A defect in deployed code is exercised by an adversary before it is found by its authors.
trigger_conditions: Code holds value or authority and is publicly reachable
No independent audit or adversarial review preceded deployment
Upgrade path is absent or itself unguarded
citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F027 Code Defect Exploitation. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F027
assessment_note: State which trigger conditions the assessed design satisfies. Report this family as examined even where no exposure is found. A parameter recommendation stated without its conditions is not conforming output under section 7.
